items.title: Asana Cuts Model Costs 76x in Browser Tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.
keyPoints: Asana utilized GPT-6 Astra in Codex for browser agent tests.
The update made the browser agent 76x cheaper to run.
Performance was also accelerated by 5x in the tested scenarios.

en.title: Asana Cuts Model Costs 76x in Browser Tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
en.summary: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.
keyPoints: Asana utilized GPT-6 Astra in Codex for browser agent tests.

Performance was also accelerated by 5x in the tested scenarios.

fr.title: Asana réduit les coûts de modèle de 76x avec GPT-6.1 Sol
fr.summary: En utilisant GPT-6 Astra dans Codex, Asana a rendu son agent de navigation 76x moins cher et 5x plus rapide lors de tests visant à offrir de meilleurs modèles.
keyPoints: Asana a employé GPT-6 Astra dans Codex pour des tests d'agents de navigation.
L'agent est devenu 76x moins cher à exécuter.
La vitesse d'exécution a été multipliée par 5.

items.title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness
items.summary: Researchers propose GenUI-Harness, a multi-agent framework pairing a Tool Agent with a GUI Coder Agent to generate front-end code for structured interfaces, reducing dialogue rounds and improving task completion.
keyPoints: GenUI-Harness combines a Tool Agent and a GUI Coder Agent.
Introduces Dynamic UX and Reward Auditor to handle RL training challenges.
Outperforms several larger frontier models on the Lite split of UI-TAU Bench.

en.title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness
en.summary: Researchers propose GenUI-Harness, a multi-agent framework pairing a Tool Agent with a GUI Coder Agent to generate front-end code for structured interfaces, reducing dialogue rounds and improving task completion.
keyPoints: GenUI-Harness combines a Tool Agent and a GUI Coder Agent.
Introduces Dynamic UX and Reward Auditor to handle RL training challenges.
Outperforms several larger frontier models on the Lite split of UI-TAU Bench.

fr.title: When Interfaces Speak: Interface utilisateur générative
fr.summary: Les chercheurs proposent GenUI-Harness, un cadre multi-agents associant un agent d'outils et un agent de codage GUI pour générer du code frontal pour des interfaces structurées.
keyPoints: GenUI-Harness associe un agent d'outils et un agent de codage GUI.
Introduit Dynamic UX et Reward Auditor pour surmonter les défis de l'apprentissage par renforcement.
Surpasse des modèles de pointe plus grands sur la division Lite d'UI-TAU Bench.

items.title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Reasoning RL
items.summary: This paper investigates how much reference guidance to provide during prefix continuation for reasoning models, deriving KL divergence and introducing Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) to improve mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
keyPoints: Studies prefix continuation to compare trajectory distributions with ideal distribution.
Derives closed-form KL divergence for a single continuation.
Introduces Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) applied to Group Relative Policy Optimization.

en.title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Reasoning RL
en.summary: This paper investigates how much reference guidance to provide during prefix continuation for reasoning models, deriving KL divergence and introducing Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) to improve mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
keyPoints: Studies prefix continuation to compare trajectory distributions with ideal distribution.
Derives closed-form KL divergence for a single continuation.
Introduces Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) applied to Group Relative Policy Optimization.

fr.title: Équilibrer le guidage de référence et la génération libre
fr.summary: Cet article étudie la quantité de guidage de référence à fournir lors de la continuation de préfixe pour les modèles de raisonnement, et introduit l'Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG).
keyPoints: Étudie la continuation de préfixe pour comparer les distributions de trajectoire.
Dérive la divergence KL sous forme close pour une continuation unique.
Introduit l'Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) pour améliorer les performances mathématiques.

items.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark for AI Game Commentary
items.summary: GameCommBench is a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports for AI-generated game commentary, paired with Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE) for structured assessment.
keyPoints: GameCommBench covers board games, sports, and esports commentary tasks.
Introduces Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE) as a structured framework.
Reveals live observation and strategic analysis as major performance bottlenecks.

en.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark for AI Game Commentary
en.summary: GameCommBench is a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports for AI-generated game commentary, paired with Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE) for structured assessment.
keyPoints: GameCommBench covers board games, sports, and esports commentary tasks.
Introduces Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE) as a structured framework.
Reveals live observation and strategic analysis as major performance bottlenecks.

fr.title: GameCommBench : Un benchmark unifié pour les commentaires
fr.summary: GameCommBench est un benchmark unifié couvrant les jeux de société, les sports et l'esport pour les commentaires de jeux générés par IA, associé à un cadre d'évaluation structuré.
keyPoints: GameCommBench couvre les jeux de société, les sports et l'esport.
Introduit l'évaluation TACE (Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation) comme cadre structuré.
Identifie l'observation en direct et l'analyse stratégique comme des goulots d'étranglement.

items.title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in NSSI
items.summary: Combining an experimental pain paradigm, EEG microstates, and deep sequence modeling, this study reveals disrupted emotion-action coupling in adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury during social pain.
keyPoints: Investigates 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with non-suicidal self-injury.
Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination at 68.55% accuracy.
Identifies weakened bidirectional MS3 and MS5 microstate transitions indicating disrupted coupling.

en.title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in NSSI
en.summary: Combining an experimental pain paradigm, EEG microstates, and deep sequence modeling, this study reveals disrupted emotion-action coupling in adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury during social pain.
keyPoints: Investigates 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with non-suicidal self-injury.
Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination at 68.55% accuracy.
Identifies weakened bidirectional MS3 and MS5 microstate transitions indicating disrupted coupling.

fr.title: La douleur sociale perturbe la dynamique cérébrale dans l'AMNS
fr.summary: Combinant un paradigme de douleur expérimentale, des micro-états EEG et de la modélisation, cette étude révèle un couplage émotion-action perturbé chez les adolescents souffrant d'automutilation.
keyPoints: Étudie 106 adolescents souffrant de dépression dont 67 avec des comportements d'automutilation.
La douleur sociale offre la meilleure discrimination des cas avec une précision de 68,55 %.
Identifie des transitions de micro-états affaiblies indiquant un couplage altéré.

items.title: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents: Admission and Presentation
items.summary: The paper distinguishes admission and presentation governance decisions for persistent memory in LLM agents, introducing factor-compiled and permission-semantic admission designs to reduce failure rates.
keyPoints: Distinguishes between memory admission and presentation governance.
Implements factor-compiled (FC) and permission-semantic (PS) admission mechanisms.
Reduces judge-assessed failure rates and cross-domain leakage significantly.

en.title: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents: Admission and Presentation
en.summary: The paper distinguishes admission and presentation governance decisions for persistent memory in LLM agents, introducing factor-compiled and permission-semantic admission designs to reduce failure rates.
keyPoints: Distinguishes between memory admission and presentation governance.
Implements factor-compiled (FC) and permission-semantic (PS) admission mechanisms.
Reduces judge-assessed failure rates and cross-domain leakage significantly.

fr.title: Gouverner la mémoire persistante dans les agents LLM
fr.summary: L'article distingue les décisions de gouvernance d'admission et de présentation pour la mémoire persistante dans les agents LLM, introduisant de nouvelles conceptions d'admission.
keyPoints: Distingue la gouvernance de l'admission et de la présentation de la mémoire.
Met en œuvre des mécanismes d'admission factor-compiled et permission-semantic.
Réduit les taux d'échec évalués et les fuites inter-domaines.

items.title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
items.summary: To address output fluctuations in Long-Term Time Series Forecasting, researchers propose AliO (Align Outputs) along with a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), to improve reliability.
keyPoints: Addresses prediction output discrepancies across lagged input sequences.
Introduces AliO to reduce time and frequency domain output discrepancies.
Proposes the Time Alignment Metric (TAM) to quantify prediction alignment.

en.title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
en.summary: To address output fluctuations in Long-Term Time Series Forecasting, researchers propose AliO (Align Outputs) along with a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), to improve reliability.
keyPoints: Addresses prediction output discrepancies across lagged input sequences.
Introduces AliO to reduce time and frequency domain output discrepancies.
Proposes the Time Alignment Metric (TAM) to quantify prediction alignment.

fr.title: AliO : L'alignement des sorties dans la prévision temporelle
fr.summary: Pour remédier aux fluctuations de sortie dans les prévisions temporelles à long terme, les chercheurs proposent AliO ainsi qu'une nouvelle métrique, le TAM, afin d'améliorer la fiabilité.
keyPoints: Traite les divergences de sortie de prévision à travers les séquences d'entrée.
Introduit AliO pour réduire les écarts temporels et fréquentiels.
Propose la métrique TAM (Time Alignment Metric) pour quantifier l'alignement.

items.title: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
items.summary: This paper presents Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process for weight-only post-training quantization that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over activation distributions.
keyPoints: Shows lower reconstruction loss can sometimes hurt new task performance.
Proposes Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ) to refine integer codes.
Improves six representative PTQ methods across dense and MoE LLMs without overhead.

en.title: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
en.summary: This paper presents Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process for weight-only post-training quantization that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over activation distributions.
keyPoints: Shows lower reconstruction loss can sometimes hurt new task performance.
Proposes Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ) to refine integer codes.
Improves six representative PTQ methods across dense and MoE LLMs without overhead.

fr.title: Raffinement robuste pour la quantification de LLM à bas bits
fr.summary: Cet article présente la Quantification Robuste Distributionnellement (DRQ), un processus de raffinement post-hoc pour la quantification minimisant la perte de reconstruction dans le pire des cas.
keyPoints: Montre qu'une perte de reconstruction plus faible peut nuire aux performances.
Propose la DRQ pour affiner les codes entiers représentant les poids quantifiés.
Améliore six méthodes PTQ représentatives sur des modèles denses et MoE.

items.title: Harness Compilation: Optimizing Decisions for Small Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Harness Compilation (HC) is an offline procedure adapting the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness, improving VLM scores significantly across visual question-answering tasks.
keyPoints: Introduces Harness Compilation (HC) as an offline task-allocation procedure.
Improves small VLM benchmark scores by 9.9 to 23.9 points.
Requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls during deployment.

en.title: Harness Compilation: Optimizing Decisions for Small Vision-Language Models
en.summary: Harness Compilation (HC) is an offline procedure adapting the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness, improving VLM scores significantly across visual question-answering tasks.
keyPoints: Introduces Harness Compilation (HC) as an offline task-allocation procedure.
Improves small VLM benchmark scores by 9.9 to 23.9 points.
Requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls during deployment.

fr.title: Harness Compilation : Optimiser les décisions pour les petits VLM
fr.summary: Harness Compilation (HC) est une procédure hors ligne qui adapte la répartition du travail entre un petit VLM gelé et son harnais externe, améliorant nettement les scores.
keyPoints: Introduit Harness Compilation (HC) comme procédure d'allocation de tâches.
Améliore les scores des petits VLM de 9,9 à 23,9 points.
Ne nécessite aucune mise à jour de poids ni appel à un enseignant lors du déploiement.

items.title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Discovery
items.summary: The Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) is proposed for autonomous closed-loop scientific discovery, featuring an identifiability engine that outputs a three-way plateau verdict.
keyPoints: Proposes LLM-IDEA for autonomous scientific discovery of mechanistic world models.
Features an identifiability engine providing a three-way plateau verdict.
Successfully reproduces known verdicts and improves discovery depth in testbeds.

en.title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Discovery
en.summary: The Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) is proposed for autonomous closed-loop scientific discovery, featuring an identifiability engine that outputs a three-way plateau verdict.
keyPoints: Proposes LLM-IDEA for autonomous scientific discovery of mechanistic world models.
Features an identifiability engine providing a three-way plateau verdict.
Successfully reproduces known verdicts and improves discovery depth in testbeds.

fr.title: LLM-IDEA : Agent expérimental pour la découverte scientifique
fr.summary: L'agent expérimental piloté par l'identifiabilité (LLM-IDEA) est proposé pour la découverte scientifique autonome en boucle fermée, doté d'un moteur d'identifiabilité.
keyPoints: Propose LLM-IDEA pour la découverte autonome de modèles de mondes mécanistiques.
Intègre un moteur d'identifiabilité fournissant un verdict de plateau à trois voies.
Reproduit des verdicts connus et améliore la profondeur de découverte dans les bancs d'essai.

items.title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.summary: TaReD introduces tool-aware recursive decomposition to help agents tackle complex long-horizon tasks. By organizing large tool libraries into a capability hierarchy, agents discover tools on demand and decompose tasks into aligned subtask trees, improving end-to-end success rates by up to 40 percentage points.
keyPoints: Organizes large tool libraries into a hierarchical capability structure.
Decomposes complex tasks into subtask trees aligned with available tools.
Improves end-to-end task success rates by up to 40 percentage points over baselines.

en.title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
en.summary: TaReD introduces tool-aware recursive decomposition to help agents tackle complex long-horizon tasks. By organizing large tool libraries into a capability hierarchy, agents discover tools on demand and decompose tasks into aligned subtask trees, improving end-to-end success rates by up to 40 percentage points.
keyPoints: Organizes large tool libraries into a hierarchical capability structure.
Decomposes complex tasks into subtask trees aligned with available tools.
Improves end-to-end task success rates by up to 40 percentage points over baselines.

fr.title: TaReD : Décomposition récursive consciente des outils pour les tâches longues
fr.summary: TaReD introduit une décomposition récursive consciente des outils pour aider les agents à gérer des tâches complexes à long terme. En organisant de grandes bibliothèques d'outils en une hiérarchie, les agents découvrent les outils à la demande et améliorent les taux de réussite.
keyPoints: Organise de grandes bibliothèques d'outils en une structure hiérarchique.
Décompose les tâches complexes en arbres de sous-tâches alignés sur les outils.
Améliore le taux de réussite de bout en bout jusqu'à 40 points de pourcentage.

items.title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
items.summary: This paper formalizes Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory to address open-ended discovery challenges with LLMs. It introduces abductive utility and possibility frontier search, achieving anytime validity and asymptotic optimization on scientific tasks.
keyPoints: Formalizes Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) via possibility theory.
Introduces abductive utility as a computable measure of discovery progress.
Presents possibility frontier search to maintain anytime validity and asymptotic optimality.

en.title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
en.summary: This paper formalizes Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory to address open-ended discovery challenges with LLMs. It introduces abductive utility and possibility frontier search, achieving anytime validity and asymptotic optimization on scientific tasks.
keyPoints: Formalizes Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) via possibility theory.
Introduces abductive utility as a computable measure of discovery progress.
Presents possibility frontier search to maintain anytime validity and asymptotic optimality.

fr.title: Découverte scientifique ouverte avec le raisonnement possibiliste
fr.summary: Cet article formalise la Découverte Scientifique Autonome Abductive (AASD) en utilisant la théorie des possibilités pour relever les défis de découverte ouverte avec les LLM. Il introduit l'utilité abductive et la recherche de frontières de possibilité.
keyPoints: Formalise la découverte scientifique autonome abductive via la théorie des possibilités.
Introduit l'utilité abductive comme mesure calculable des progrès de la découverte.
Présente la recherche de frontières de possibilité pour maintenir la validité.

items.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
items.summary: ORDO recasts mixed-integer programming (MIP) presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over an atomic action space. By using sequence racing via SCIP modifications, it achieves cross-domain zero-shot speedups for presolve action sequences.
keyPoints: Recasts MIP presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation.
Introduces ORDO for operation-level round-aware dynamic ordering.
Enables cross-domain zero-shot speedups using sequence racing in SCIP.

en.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
en.summary: ORDO recasts mixed-integer programming (MIP) presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over an atomic action space. By using sequence racing via SCIP modifications, it achieves cross-domain zero-shot speedups for presolve action sequences.
keyPoints: Recasts MIP presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation.
Introduces ORDO for operation-level round-aware dynamic ordering.
Enables cross-domain zero-shot speedups using sequence racing in SCIP.

fr.title: ORDO : Ordonnancement dynamique pour le prétraitement MIP
fr.summary: ORDO reformule la planification du prétraitement de la programmation en nombres entiers mixtes (MIP) en génération de séquences autorégressives. En utilisant la course de séquences, il permet des accélérations zero-shot inter-domaines.
keyPoints: Reformule la planification du prétraitement MIP en génération de séquences.
Introduit ORDO pour un ordonnancement dynamique conscient des tours.
Permet des accélérations zero-shot inter-domaines grâce à la course de séquences.

items.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice
items.summary: DuplexAgent combines a full-duplex live interaction model with asynchronous delegation for reasoning and coding. Its harness uses six editable modules revised iteratively via Duplex-Harness-RSI, improving spoken-knowledge and tool scores on benchmarks.
keyPoints: Combines full-duplex continuous interaction with asynchronous task delegation.
Defines a harness with six editable modules revised through a closed loop.
Achieves strong spoken-knowledge and tool execution scores on benchmarks.

en.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice
en.summary: DuplexAgent combines a full-duplex live interaction model with asynchronous delegation for reasoning and coding. Its harness uses six editable modules revised iteratively via Duplex-Harness-RSI, improving spoken-knowledge and tool scores on benchmarks.
keyPoints: Combines full-duplex continuous interaction with asynchronous task delegation.
Defines a harness with six editable modules revised through a closed loop.
Achieves strong spoken-knowledge and tool execution scores on benchmarks.

fr.title: DuplexAgent-RSI : Amélioration récursive pour l'agent vocal duplex
fr.summary: DuplexAgent combine un modèle d'interaction en direct en duplex intégral avec une délégation asynchrone. Son harnais utilise six modules modifiables révisés itérativement via Duplex-Harness-RSI, améliorant les performances sur les benchmarks.
keyPoints: Combine une interaction continue en duplex intégral avec une délégation asynchrone.
Définit un harnais avec six modules modifiables révisés en boucle fermée.
Atteint de solides scores de connaissances vocales et d'exécution d'outils.

items.title: MedBenchAgent: Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmarks
items.summary: MedBenchAgent introduces constrained compilation to automate the construction of medical vision-language model benchmarks. Using a Benchmark Intermediate Representation, it achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9% and passes rigorous audits.
keyPoints: Formulates medical VLM benchmark construction as constrained compilation.
Employs a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) across stages.
Achieves a 90.9% Task-Space F1 score, outperforming direct task induction.

en.title: MedBenchAgent: Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmarks
en.summary: MedBenchAgent introduces constrained compilation to automate the construction of medical vision-language model benchmarks. Using a Benchmark Intermediate Representation, it achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9% and passes rigorous audits.
keyPoints: Formulates medical VLM benchmark construction as constrained compilation.
Employs a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) across stages.
Achieves a 90.9% Task-Space F1 score, outperforming direct task induction.

fr.title: MedBenchAgent : Automatisation des benchmarks VLM médicaux
fr.summary: MedBenchAgent introduit une compilation contrainte pour automatiser la construction de benchmarks de modèles vision-langage médicaux. À l'aide d'une représentation intermédiaire, il atteint un F1 de l'espace des tâches de 90,9 %.
keyPoints: Formule la construction de benchmarks VLM médicaux comme une compilation contrainte.
Utilise une représentation intermédiaire de benchmark (BIR).
Atteint un score F1 de 90,9 % pour l'espace des tâches.

items.title: DivMoE: Fine-Grained MoE Upcycling via Cross-Domain Expert
items.summary: DivMoE presents fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts upcycling with structurally-balanced routing to solve naive routing collapse. By utilizing domain-specialized initialization and diversity-constrained routing, it consistently outperforms baseline upcycling methods.
keyPoints: Addresses fine-grained MoE upcycling structural routing collapse.
Introduces domain-specialized expert initialization and diversity-constrained routing.
Outperforms baseline upcycling methods across 15 benchmarks.

en.title: DivMoE: Fine-Grained MoE Upcycling via Cross-Domain Expert
en.summary: DivMoE presents fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts upcycling with structurally-balanced routing to solve naive routing collapse. By utilizing domain-specialized initialization and diversity-constrained routing, it consistently outperforms baseline upcycling methods.
keyPoints: Addresses fine-grained MoE upcycling structural routing collapse.
Introduces domain-specialized expert initialization and diversity-constrained routing.
Outperforms baseline upcycling methods across 15 benchmarks.

fr.title: DivMoE : Surcyclage MoE fin via composition d'experts croisés
fr.summary: DivMoE présente un surcyclage de Mélange d'Experts (MoE) à grain fin avec un routage structurellement équilibré pour résoudre l'effondrement du routage. Il surpasse systématiquement les méthodes de référence sur 15 benchmarks.
keyPoints: Résout l'effondrement du routage structurel dans le surcyclage MoE à grain fin.
Introduit une initialisation spécialisée et un routage contraint par la diversité.
Surpasse les méthodes de surcyclage de référence sur 15 benchmarks.

items.title: Finsler Flow Matching: Dynamics-Aware Geodesic Interpolation
items.summary: Finsler Flow Matching (FFM) learns continuous stochastic dynamics from discrete Markov transition graphs. By combining local moments into a Finsler structure, it improves single-cell trajectory inference and recovery of intermediate populations.
keyPoints: Introduces Finsler Flow Matching for continuous dynamics from Markov graphs.
Uses local moments to construct an anisotropic Finsler structure.
Improves trajectory inference and recovery of withheld intermediate populations.

en.title: Finsler Flow Matching: Dynamics-Aware Geodesic Interpolation
en.summary: Finsler Flow Matching (FFM) learns continuous stochastic dynamics from discrete Markov transition graphs. By combining local moments into a Finsler structure, it improves single-cell trajectory inference and recovery of intermediate populations.
keyPoints: Introduces Finsler Flow Matching for continuous dynamics from Markov graphs.
Uses local moments to construct an anisotropic Finsler structure.
Improves trajectory inference and recovery of withheld intermediate populations.

fr.title: Finsler Flow Matching : Interpolation géodésique pour l'inférence
fr.summary: Finsler Flow Matching (FFM) apprend des dynamiques stochastiques continues à partir de graphiques de transition de Markov discrets. En combinant des moments locaux en une structure de Finsler, il améliore l'inférence de trajectoire.
keyPoints: Introduit l'appariement de flux de Finsler pour des dynamiques continues.
Utilise des moments locaux pour construire une structure de Finsler anisée.
Améliore l'inférence de trajectoire cellulaire et la récupération de populations.

items.title: Mine Odyssey: Benchmarking Spatial Agentic Intelligence in the Wild
items.summary: Mine Odyssey evaluates agentic spatial intelligence using Minecraft reconstructions of 30 real-world locations across 20 countries. Testing eight state-of-the-art models reveals significant performance gaps among current artificial intelligence systems.
keyPoints: Introduces a benchmark using Minecraft reconstructions of 30 real-world locations.
Comprises 180 tasks testing route-finding, navigation, and error recovery.
Shows GPT-6 Astra leading with an 85.6% success rate, highlighting open gaps.

en.title: Mine Odyssey: Benchmarking Spatial Agentic Intelligence in the Wild
en.summary: Mine Odyssey evaluates agentic spatial intelligence using Minecraft reconstructions of 30 real-world locations across 20 countries. Testing eight state-of-the-art models reveals significant performance gaps among current artificial intelligence systems.
keyPoints: Introduces a benchmark using Minecraft reconstructions of 30 real-world locations.
Comprises 180 tasks testing route-finding, navigation, and error recovery.
Shows GPT-6 Astra leading with an 85.6% success rate, highlighting open gaps.

fr.title: Mine Odyssey : Évaluation de l'intelligence spatiale des agents
fr.summary: Mine Odyssey évalue l'intelligence spatiale des agents à l'aide de reconstructions Minecraft de 30 emplacements réels. Le test de huit modèles de pointe révèle d'importants écarts de performance au sein des systèmes actuels.
keyPoints: Introduit un benchmark utilisant des reconstructions Minecraft de lieux réels.
Comprend 180 tâches testant la navigation et la récupération d'erreurs.
Montre que GPT-6 Astra est en tête avec un taux de réussite de 85,6 %.

items.title: TokenBank: Financial Infrastructure for AI Services
items.summary: TokenBank provides financial infrastructure for AI services via structured contracts, supporting service consumption rights, forwards, revenue-based financing, and failure protections. Evaluation across API requests and agent executions validates its mechanics.
keyPoints: Proposes financial infrastructure representing commitments via structured contracts.
Supports service rights, forward agreements, financing, and protection claims.
Evaluated via extensive API request replays and agent execution scenarios.

en.title: TokenBank: Financial Infrastructure for AI Services
en.summary: TokenBank provides financial infrastructure for AI services via structured contracts, supporting service consumption rights, forwards, revenue-based financing, and failure protections. Evaluation across API requests and agent executions validates its mechanics.
keyPoints: Proposes financial infrastructure representing commitments via structured contracts.
Supports service rights, forward agreements, financing, and protection claims.
Evaluated via extensive API request replays and agent execution scenarios.

fr.title: TokenBank : Infrastructure financière pour les services d'IA
fr.summary: TokenBank fournit une infrastructure financière pour les services d'IA via des contrats structurés, prenant en charge les droits de consommation, les contrats à terme et le financement. L'évaluation valide ses mécanismes économiques.
keyPoints: Propose une infrastructure financière représentant des engagements par contrats.
Prend en charge les droits de service, les contrats à terme et le financement.
Évalué via des relectures de requêtes API et des scénarios d'exécution d'agents.

items.title: ReCast: Attribution-Oriented Step Representation Learning
items.summary: ReCast introduces attribution-oriented step representation learning to identify root-cause failures in LLM-based agent systems. By transforming hidden states with contrastive objectives and using ReCast-2K, it achieves superior performance across benchmarks.
keyPoints: Addresses failure attribution in LLM-based agent systems.
Transforms frozen LLM hidden states into attribution-oriented representations.
Introduces ReCast-2K dataset and achieves top Hit@1 across benchmarks.

en.title: ReCast: Attribution-Oriented Step Representation Learning
en.summary: ReCast introduces attribution-oriented step representation learning to identify root-cause failures in LLM-based agent systems. By transforming hidden states with contrastive objectives and using ReCast-2K, it achieves superior performance across benchmarks.
keyPoints: Addresses failure attribution in LLM-based agent systems.
Transforms frozen LLM hidden states into attribution-oriented representations.
Introduces ReCast-2K dataset and achieves top Hit@1 across benchmarks.

fr.title: ReCast : Apprentissage de représentation d'étapes orienté attribution
fr.summary: ReCast présente un apprentissage de représentation d'étapes orienté attribution pour identifier les échecs dans les systèmes d'agents basés sur les LLM. Il transforme les états cachés pour surpasser les méthodes existantes.
keyPoints: Traite l'attribution des échecs dans les systèmes d'agents basés sur les LLM.
Transforme les états cachés en représentations orientées attribution.
Introduit le jeu de données ReCast-2K et atteint les meilleures performances.
